label: Sample (BK-12): made-up answers for one made-up student's Study permit case, saved and confirmed by api/src/sample-case.ts from samples/sample-cases.json. Never a client, never submitted. No value here is an IRCC value. Unconfirmed: expert. Legal: Unconfirmed: no counsel.
source: Made up for BK-12 (P-448, P-449: a pathway's Sample case is chosen in data). Only questions the Study permit's release asks are answered (an answer it does not ask is refused in words by the loader). BK-13 step 1 (P-449, P-481 S6): widened so the Study permit's forms can be written: every made-up answer the release asks of a single student of 20 studying outside Québec, with no representative-only release and no custodian. Option values are the release's own lists (for example IMM 1294's "F Female").
